subbench.objective: What an engine pays to EDIT a large text file: the cost of a global substitution over a few-hundred-MB Apache access log, split by what dominates it -- copying (a literal), searching (a rare two-literal alternation), per-match output (every digit run), capture rearrangement, class-heavy masking (IPv4, e-mail), a case-forcing template, and a backreference inside a negative lookahead with a conditional template (the VM-only, DFA-refusing shape). The answer is an OUTPUT BYTE STRING, so the correctness gate is its sha256 against the libpcre2 oracle's.
